name: personal-project-knowledge
description: Codex adapter for the portable Personal Project Knowledge MCP plugin and skill.

interface.shortDescription: Local memory and Markdown knowledge base.
interface.longDescription: Installs the portable personal-project-knowledge MCP and skills into Codex. On first install, use the config skill to guide data root, memory sizing, budgets, and semantic type setup. The shared skills manage auto-loaded memories, indexed Markdown docs, decisions, requirement changes, preferences, project rules, and safe configuration changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: If this MCP was just installed, use personal-project-knowledge-config to guide setup; otherwise use personal project knowledge to recall or update memories and project documentation.
